frequency_question: How often do executive-led tariff threats result in implementation within the specified timeframe when the principal possesses the will and legal capability?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a U.S. president announced specific tariff rates on specific partner nations using broad statutory authorities and maintained the policy through the implementation window. Excluded are threats used merely as leverage that were permanently dropped prior to announcement of execution.
coverage_note: 9 named major unilateral tariff implementations matching the executive authority profile; universe of clear unilateral executive tariff enactments since modern trade acts.
known_gaps: Some minor or short-lived retaliatory duties may be omitted, but major instances of declared tariffs by powerful executives are fully captured.
validity_reason: Valid through the remainder of the current presidential administration's structural use of executive trade authorities.
